This page documents the **CRISalid message bus**, with a global view of exchanges and queues, followed by detailed
documentation for each exchange and its messages.

---

## 🌐 Global Map of Exchanges and Queues

CRISalid currently relies on several RabbitMQ exchanges to make its services communicate asynchronously.

In crisalid-bus, all exchanges are of type `topic` and use an "at-least-once" delivery strategy, which means that
messages may be delivered more than once in case of failure, and consumers must be designed to handle potential
duplicates and be idempotent. Consumers, in turn, must be able to handle the possibility of missing messages (e.g., by
carefully processing "unchanged" events or implementing reconciliation mechanisms).

Messages are primarily of two types: **events** and **tasks**.

- **Events** represent occurrences or changes in the system (e.g., "a person was created", "a publication was
  harvested"). They are typically **not acknowledged** (i.e., they are fire-and-forget).
- **Tasks** represent work that needs to be done (e.g., "harvest this publication"). They may be **acknowledged** (i.e.,
  the producer expects a confirmation that the task was received and will be processed).

---

## 🧭 Exchange Overview Table

| Exchange       | Purpose                                      | Type    | Delivery strategy | Documented messages                                |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------|---------|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `directory`    | Institutional directories and reference data | `topic` | at-least-once     | people, structures                                 |
| `publications` | Publication harvesting workflows             | `topic` | at-least-once     | publication, harvestings                           |
| `graph`        | Downstream graph-facing integrations         | `topic` | at-least-once     | people, structures, <br/>publications, harvestings |

---

## 🔀 Routing key convention — interactive vs batch

All queues in the CRISalid bus will progressively be split into two queues suffixed **`-interactive`** and **`-batch`**.
When a queue has been split, every message routed to it gains a **5th routing key segment**: `.interactive` or `.batch`.

- **`.interactive`** — message triggered by a real-time user action (e.g. a user requesting a document harvest, an
  operator editing a person record). Processing must be fast and must not be starved by bulk loads.
- **`.batch`** — message produced by an ETL pipeline or mass-import job. Processing can tolerate higher latency.

Each split queue has its own channel and prefetch count, its own semaphore, and its own dead-letter queue on
`dlx.graph` so failures in one traffic class do not affect the other.

**Current status:**

| Service | Split done? | Queue names |
|---|---|---|
| sovisuplus | ✅ | `sovisuplus-interactive`, `sovisuplus-batch` |
| crisalid-ikg (inbound actions) | ✅ | `crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive` |
| crisalid-ikg (inbound directory) | ✅ | `crisalid-ikg-people-batch`, `crisalid-ikg-structures-batch` |
| crisalid-ikg (publications) | ⏳ pending | `crisalid-ikg-publications`, `crisalid-ikg-harvesting-events` |

## 🗺️ Existing Queues

### Queue Inventory

| Queue | Exchange | Binding keys | Producer(s) | Consumer(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crisalid-ikg-people-batch` | `directory` | `event.people.person.*.batch` | ETL pipelines | crisalid-ikg | |
| `crisalid-ikg-structures-batch` | `directory` | `event.structures.structure.*.batch` | ETL pipelines | crisalid-ikg | |
| `crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive` | `graph` | `task.*.*.*.interactive` | sovisuplus | crisalid-ikg | DLQ on `dlx.graph` |
| `dlq.crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive` | `dlx.graph` | `#` | dead-letter | manual | Dead-letter queue |
| `sovisuplus-interactive` | `graph` | `event.*.*.*.interactive` | crisalid-ikg | sovisuplus | DLQ on `dlx.graph` |
| `sovisuplus-batch` | `graph` | `event.*.*.*.batch` | crisalid-ikg | sovisuplus | DLQ on `dlx.graph` |
| `dlq.sovisuplus-interactive` | `dlx.graph` | `#` | dead-letter | manual | Dead-letter queue |
| `dlq.sovisuplus-batch` | `dlx.graph` | `#` | dead-letter | manual | Dead-letter queue |
| `crisalid-ikg-publications` | `publications` | `event.references.reference.*` | svp-harvester | crisalid-ikg | |
| `crisalid-ikg-harvesting-events` | `publications` | `event.references.*.*` | svp-harvester | crisalid-ikg | |
| `svp-harvester` | `publications` | `task.entity.references.retrieval` | crisalid-ikg | svp-harvester | |
| `ctd-publications` | `publications` | `event.references.reference.*` | svp-harvester | CTD | |

## 📚 Documentation by Exchange

---

## Exchange : `directory`

### Purpose

Messages from institutional directories and related structure / people synchronization workflows.

### Exchange Type

```text
topic
````

### Delivery Strategy

```text
at-least-once
```

### Topic and Routing Key Patterns

There are two main patterns for routing keys in the `directory` exchange:

```text
event.structures.structure.<action>
event.people.person.<action>
```

<details>
<summary>Full list of actions for each entity type</summary>
```text
event.structures.structure.created
event.structures.structure.updated
event.structures.structure.deleted
event.structures.structure.unchanged
event.people.person.created
event.people.person.updated
event.people.person.deleted
event.people.person.unchanged
```
</details>

### Message Catalog for `directory` exchange

---

#### Structure events (`directory` exchange)

##### Routing keys

Pattern:

```text
event.structures.structure.<action>
```

<details>
<summary>Full list of routing keys for structure events</summary>
```text
event.structures.structure.created
event.structures.structure.updated
event.structures.structure.deleted
event.structures.structure.unchanged
```
</details>

##### Ack required

```text
no
```

##### Payload

<details>
<summary>JSON schema for structure events</summary>

```json
{
  "structures_event": {
    "type": "created|updated|deleted|unchanged",
    "data": {
      "generic_type": "institution|institution_subdivision|unit|unit_subdivision|team",
      "type": "EPE|UNIV|UMR|UR|UAR|IRL|UFR|FAC|...",
      "local_types": [
        {
          "value": "<string>",
          "language": "<language code>"
        }
      ],
      "main_mission": "research|scientific_services|administrative_services|teaching",
      "secondary_missions": [
        "research|scientific_services|administrative_services|teaching"
      ],
      "long_labels": [
        {
          "value": "<string>",
          "language": "<language code>"
        }
      ],
      "short_labels": [
        {
          "value": "<string>",
          "language": "<language code>"
        }
      ],
      "descriptions": [
        {
          "value": "<string>",
          "language": "<language code>"
        }
      ],
      "hceres_research_areas": [
        "<string>"
      ],
      "erc_research_fields": [
        "<string>"
      ],
      "hal_collection": "<string|null>",
      "contacts": [
        {
          "type": "<string>",
          "format": "<string>",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "identifiers": [
        {
          "type": "local|uai|nns|ror|wikidata|scopus",
          "value": "<string>"
        }
      ],
      "relationships": [
        {
          "type": "member_of",
          "subtype": "main_supervision|associated_supervision|participating_supervision|null",
          "target": "<string>",
          "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
          "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null"
        },
        {
          "type": "part_of",
          "target": "<string>",
          "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
          "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

##### Additional considerations

* A research structure must have a generic type **and** at least one type or local type.
* Relationships of type "member_of" can have a subtype _only_ when characterizing the supervision of a research unit.
  Inclusion relationships ("part_of") do not have subtypes.
* The targets of relationships must be the tracking ids of structures already created in previous messages, except for
  external institutions that you do not manage: in this case,
  simply indicate "uai-1234" or "ror-ABCD" according to the type of identifier you have for the external institution.
* For details on typologies, see the CRISalid
  Wiki: https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/spaces/ESUPCRISalid/pages/1673035787/Import+des+donn%C3%A9es+structures+v2

#### People events (`directory` exchange)

##### Routing keys

Pattern:

```text
event.people.person.<action>
```

<details>
<summary>Full list of routing keys for people events</summary>
```text
event.people.person.created
event.people.person.updated
event.people.person.deleted
event.people.person.unchanged
```
</details>

##### Ack required

```text
no
```

##### Payload

<details>
<summary>JSON schema for people events</summary>

```json
{
  "people_event": {
    "type": "created|updated|deleted|unchanged",
    "data": {
      "display_name": "<string>",

        "<string>"
      ],
      "names": [

          "value": "012345678"
        }
      ],
      "memberships": [
        {
          "entity_uid": "local-U123",
          "start_date": "2020-09-01",
          "end_date": null
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>Example of a "deleted" event</summary>

```json
{
  "people_event": {
    "type": "deleted",
    "data": {
      "names": [
        {
          "first_names": [
            {
              "value": "Paul",
              "language": "fr"
            }
          ],
          "last_names": [
            {
              "value": "Bernard",
              "language": "fr"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "identifiers": [
        {
          "type": "local",
          "value": "pbernard@univ-example.fr"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

##### Additional considerations

* Either `display_name` or at least one entry in `names` must be provided. If `display_name` is absent, it is
  computed automatically from the first available name.
* `display_name_variants` is optional. Use it when the person is known under multiple forms of their name
  (e.g. birth name alongside married name, or initials).
* A person may have multiple `names` entries — use one entry per distinct name form (birth name, married name, pseudonym).
* Identifier types: `local` (institutional login or employee id), `orcid`, `idref`, `idhals` (HAL login),
  `idhali` (HAL numeric id), `scopus`.
* `memberships.entity_uid` must reference a research structure already known to IKG, using either the `local-<id>`
  format or an external identifier prefix such as `uai-<code>`.
* `employments.entity_uid` references an institution. The `position.code` must be a valid HCERES position code
  (e.g. `PR`, `MCF`, `DR`, `CR`, `IR`, `Post-doc`).
* `external: true` marks people who are not managed by the institution (e.g. co-authors discovered through
  publication harvesting). External people carry no `memberships` or `employments`.

## Exchange : `graph`

### Purpose

Bidirectional exchange between crisalid-ikg and downstream consumers (primarily sovisuplus).

- **crisalid-ikg → sovisuplus**: lifecycle events for people, research units, documents, and harvesting state/results.
- **sovisuplus → crisalid-ikg**: task messages representing user-initiated graph operations (merge documents, fetch
  publications, update a person, etc.).

### Exchange Type

```text
topic
```

### Delivery Strategy

```text
at-least-once
```

### Topic and Routing Key Patterns

All routing keys on the `graph` exchange have **5 segments**, where the last segment is the **queue mode**
(see [Routing key convention — interactive vs batch](#routing-key-convention-interactive-vs-batch)):

```text
event.structures.structure.<action>.<mode>
event.people.person.<action>.<mode>
event.documents.document.<action>.<mode>
event.harvestings.<event_type>.<action>.<mode>
task.documents.document.<action>.<mode>
task.people.person.<action>.<mode>
task.people.documents.fetch.<mode>
```

Where `<mode>` is `interactive` or `batch`.

<details>
<summary>Full list of event routing keys</summary>
```text
event.structures.structure.created.interactive
event.structures.structure.updated.interactive
event.structures.structure.deleted.interactive
event.structures.structure.unchanged.interactive
event.structures.structure.created.batch
event.structures.structure.updated.batch
event.structures.structure.deleted.batch
event.structures.structure.unchanged.batch

event.people.person.created.interactive
event.people.person.updated.interactive
event.people.person.deleted.interactive
event.people.person.unchanged.interactive
event.people.person.created.batch
event.people.person.updated.batch
event.people.person.deleted.batch
event.people.person.unchanged.batch

event.documents.document.created.interactive
event.documents.document.updated.interactive
event.documents.document.deleted.interactive
event.documents.document.unchanged.interactive
event.documents.document.created.batch
event.documents.document.updated.batch
event.documents.document.deleted.batch
event.documents.document.unchanged.batch

event.harvestings.harvesting_state_event.*.interactive
event.harvestings.harvesting_result_event.*.interactive
event.harvestings.harvesting_state_event.*.batch
event.harvestings.harvesting_result_event.*.batch
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Full list of task routing keys (sovisuplus → crisalid-ikg)</summary>
```text
task.documents.document.merge.interactive
task.documents.document.unmerge.interactive
task.people.person.update.interactive
task.people.documents.fetch.interactive
```
</details>

### Message Catalog for `graph` exchange

#### Structure events (`graph` exchange)

##### Routing keys

Pattern:

```text
event.structures.structure.<action>.<mode>
```

<details>
<summary>Full list of routing keys for structure events</summary>
```text
event.structures.structure.created.interactive
event.structures.structure.updated.interactive
event.structures.structure.deleted.interactive
event.structures.structure.unchanged.interactive
event.structures.structure.created.batch
event.structures.structure.updated.batch
event.structures.structure.deleted.batch
event.structures.structure.unchanged.batch
```
</details>

##### Ack required

```text
no
```

##### Payload

The payload is a flat object with three top-level keys. The `fields` section contains all data available for
the structure in the IKG graph. `main_mission` and `secondary_missions` are only present for `unit` type
structures (research units, support units, administrative units).

<details>
<summary>JSON schema for structure events</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "unit|institution|institution_subdivision|unit_subdivision|team",
  "event": "created|updated|deleted|unchanged",
  "fields": {
    "uid": "<string>",
    "national_type": "UMR|UAR|UR|IRL|UNIV|EPE|EPST|GE|COMUE|UFR|FAC|TEAM|THEME|null",
    "local_types": [
      {
        "value": "<string>",
        "language": "<language code>"
      }
    ],
    "identifiers": [
      {
        "type": "local|uai|nns|ror|wikidata|scopus",
        "value": "<string>"
      }
    ],
    "long_labels": [
      {
        "value": "<string>",
        "language": "<language code>"
      }
    ],
    "short_labels": [
      {
        "value": "<string>",
        "language": "<language code>"
      }
    ],
    "descriptions": [
      {
        "value": "<string>",
        "language": "<language code>"
      }
    ],
    "memberships": [
      {
        "target": "<uid of the supervising or member-of organisation>",
        "position": "main_supervision|associated_supervision|participating_supervision|null",
        "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
        "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null"
      }
    ],
    "parents": [
      {
        "target": "<uid of the structurally containing organisation>",
        "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
        "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD|null"
      }
    ],
    "addresses": [
      {
        "street": [{"value": "<string>", "language": "<language code>"}],
        "city": [{"value": "<string>", "language": "<language code>"}],
        "zip_code": [{"value": "<string>", "language": "<language code>"}],
        "country": [{"value": "<string>", "language": "<language code>"}]
      }
    ],
    "electronical_addresses": [
      {
        "uri": "<string>"
      }
    ],
    "main_mission": "research|scientific_services|administrative_services|teaching",
    "secondary_missions": [
      "research|scientific_services|administrative_services|teaching"
    ],
    "external": false
  }
}
```

> `main_mission` and `secondary_missions` are only present when `type` is `unit`.
> `external` is `false` for structures sourced from the institutional directory, and `true` for structures
> auto-created by IKG from the national registry (e.g. a supervising institution referenced by uid but not
> directly sent by the directory).

</details>

###### Example payloads

<details>
<summary>Example of an "unchanged" event for a team with axis membership</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "team",
  "event": "unchanged",
  "fields": {
    "uid": "local-TEAM-ASTRO-001",
    "national_type": "TEAM",
    "local_types": [],
    "identifiers": [
      {"type": "local", "value": "TEAM-ASTRO-001"}
    ],
    "long_labels": [
      {"value": "Équipe astrophysique théorique", "language": "fr"},
      {"value": "Theoretical Astrophysics Team", "language": "en"}
    ],
    "short_labels": [],
    "descriptions": [],
    "memberships": [
      {
        "target": "local-AXIS-OBS-001",
        "position": null,
        "start_date": "2010-01-01",
        "end_date": null
      }
    ],
    "parents": [
      {
        "target": "local-123456",
        "start_date": "2010-01-01",
        "end_date": null
      }
    ],
    "addresses": [],
    "electronical_addresses": [],
    "external": false
  }
}
```

</details>

##### Additional considerations

* The `type` field reflects the structure's `generic_type`: `unit` (research and support units), `institution`,
  `institution_subdivision`, `unit_subdivision`, `team`.
* `main_mission` and `secondary_missions` are only present when `type` is `unit`. They are absent for
  institutions, institution subdivisions, unit subdivisions, and teams.
* `memberships` carries `MEMBER_OF` relationships (supervision chains for research units; org-level membership
  for teams and subdivisions). The `position` field is only set for supervision relationships
  (`main_supervision`, `associated_supervision`, `participating_supervision`).
* `parents` carries `PART_OF` relationships (structural inclusion — e.g. a faculty inside a university,
  a team inside a research unit).
* `addresses` and `electronical_addresses` are included in the schema for completeness but are currently
  empty in all events — contact data is not yet persisted in the graph.
* The `uid` is the IKG-computed primary key (e.g. `local-123456`, `uai-0751818J`). It is stable for the
  lifetime of the structure and can be used as a join key across events.
* `external: false` means the structure was sourced from the institution's own directory. `external: true`
  means the structure was auto-created by IKG from the national registry because it appeared as a relationship
  target (e.g. a supervising institution referenced by a UAI or ROR identifier but never sent directly by the
  directory). Registry-created structures carry only a limited set of fields (labels, identifiers, address).
* An `unchanged` event is published when the inbound directory message produced no changes in the graph.
  Consumers implementing reconciliation logic can use it to confirm that the structure is still active.
* A `deleted` event signals that the structure has been removed from the graph. Consumers should treat
  subsequent references to its `uid` as invalid.

## Queues: `sovisuplus-interactive` and `sovisuplus-batch`

### Overview

sovisuplus subscribes to two queues on the `graph` exchange. Both queues are asserted by sovisuplus at startup —
no manual pre-creation is required, but the `dlx.graph` dead-letter exchange must exist beforehand (it is declared
in `definitions.sample.json`).

| Queue | Binding keys | Prefetch | Env var |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sovisuplus-interactive` | `event.*.*.*.interactive` | 5 | `AMQP_INTERACTIVE_QUEUE_NAME` |
| `sovisuplus-batch` | `event.*.*.*.batch` | 20 | `AMQP_BATCH_QUEUE_NAME` |

Each queue has a corresponding dead-letter queue (`dlq.sovisuplus-interactive`, `dlq.sovisuplus-batch`) bound to
`dlx.graph` with the source queue name as routing key (e.g. `sovisuplus-interactive` for `dlq.sovisuplus-interactive`).
Failed messages (handler throws) are nacked without requeue and routed to the DLQ.

sovisuplus also **publishes** task messages to the `graph` exchange. These are consumed by `crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive`.

### Inbound messages

All inbound messages share the same top-level envelope:

```json
{
  "type": "<entity type>",
  "event": "<action>",
  "fields": { ... }
}
```

#### Person events

Routing key pattern: `event.people.person.<action>.<mode>`

```json
{
  "type": "person",
  "event": "created|updated|deleted|unchanged",
  "fields": {
    "uid": "<string>",
    "identifiers": [
      {
        "type": "local|orcid|idref|idhals|idhali|scopus",
        "value": "<string>"
      }
    ],
    "display_name": "<string>",
    "first_name": "<string>",
    "last_name": "<string>",
    "external": true,
    "memberships": [
      {
        "entity_uid": "<string>",
        "research_unit": {
          "names": ["<string>"],
          "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }]
        },
        "start_date": "<ISO date|null>",
        "end_date": "<ISO date|null>"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

#### Research unit events

Routing key pattern: `event.structures.structure.<action>.<mode>`

The payload schema is identical to structure events documented in [Structure events (`graph` exchange)](#structure-events-graph-exchange).

#### Document events

Routing key pattern: `event.documents.document.<action>.<mode>`

```json
{
  "type": "document",
  "event": "created|updated|deleted|unchanged",
  "fields": {
    "uid": "<string>",
    "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }],
    "titles": [{ "value": "<string>", "language": "<string>" }]
  }
}
```

#### Harvesting events

Routing key pattern: `event.harvestings.<event_type>.<action>.<mode>`

There are two subtypes:

**Harvesting state event** (`event_type = harvesting_state_event`):

```json
{
  "type": "harvesting_state_event",
  "event": "started|running|completed|error",
  "fields": {
    "harvester": "<string>",
    "state": "running|completed|error",
    "error": ["<string>"],
    "entity": {
      "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }],
      "name": "<string>"
    }
  }
}
```

**Harvesting result event** (`event_type = harvesting_result_event`):

```json
{
  "type": "harvesting_result_event",
  "event": "created|updated|unchanged|deleted",
  "fields": {
    "reference_event": {
      "type": "created|updated|unchanged|deleted",
      "reference": {
        "source_identifier": "<string>",
        "harvester": "<string>",
        "harvester_version": "<string>",
        "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }],
        "titles": [{ "value": "<string>", "language": "<string>" }],
        "subtitles": [{ "value": "<string>", "language": "<string>" }],
        "abstracts": [{ "value": "<string>", "language": "<string|null>" }],
        "document_type": [{ "uri": "<string>", "label": "<string>" }],
        "contributions": [
          {
            "rank": "<integer|null>",
            "role": "<string|null>",
            "contributor": {
              "name": "<string|null>",
              "first_name": "<string|null>",
              "last_name": "<string|null>",
              "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }]
            }
          }
        ],
        "issued": "<ISO date|null>",
        "raw_issued": "<string|null>",
        "version": "<integer>"
      },
      "enhanced": true
    },
    "entity": {
      "identifiers": [{ "type": "<string>", "value": "<string>" }],
      "name": "<string>"
    }
  }
}
```

### Outbound messages (sovisuplus → `crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive`)

sovisuplus publishes task messages to the `graph` exchange with routing keys of the form
`task.<domain>.<entity>.<action>.interactive`. All outbound messages from sovisuplus carry the `.interactive`
suffix — batch task publishing is not implemented.

The queue `crisalid-ikg-actions-interactive` is bound to receive all `task.*.*.*.interactive` keys.

```json
{
  "id": "<uuid>",
  "actionType": "ADD|REMOVE|UPDATE|FETCH|MERGE",
  "targetType": "DOCUMENT|PERSON|HARVESTING",
  "targetUid": "<string>",
  "path": "<string|null>",
  "parameters": { ... },
  "timestamp": "<ISO datetime>",
  "personUid": "<string>",
  "application": "sovisuplus"
}
```

`actionType` and `targetType` are Prisma enum values serialized as uppercase strings.

| `actionType` | `targetType` | Routing key |
|---|---|---|
| `MERGE` | `DOCUMENT` | `task.documents.document.merge.interactive` |
| `REMOVE` | `DOCUMENT` | `task.documents.document.remove.interactive` |
| `ADD` | `DOCUMENT` | `task.documents.document.add.interactive` |
| `UPDATE` | `PERSON` | `task.people.person.update.interactive` |
| `FETCH` | `HARVESTING` | `task.people.documents.fetch.interactive` |

---
